subtitle: Understand how distortion shapes tone, harmonic content, and playing technique in different musical contexts.

introduction.title: Distortion: More Than Just Volume
introduction.text: Distortion doesn't just make things louder -- it adds harmonic content that didn't exist in the original signal, creating richness and sustain. Different types of distortion serve different musical purposes. The key is matching the distortion character to the song's needs.

columns.title: Harmonic Enhancement
columns.text: Distortion clips the waveform, creating additional harmonics that give the characteristic "warm" or "aggressive" sound

columns.title: Musical Function
columns.text: Use the minimum amount of distortion needed to achieve the musical effect you want

cards.title: Picking Dynamics
cards.description: Light overdrive responds to picking dynamics. Hard picking increases distortion, soft picking cleans up the sound.
items: Practice controlling dynamics to shape your tone

cards.title: Palm Muting
cards.description: Essential for controlling high-gain distortion. Creates tight, focused sound and prevents unwanted feedback.
items: Crucial technique for metal and hard rock

cards.title: Note Clarity
cards.description: High distortion can mask poor technique. Focus on clean fretting and precise timing to maintain clarity.

cards.title: Too Much Gain
cards.description: More distortion isn't always better. Excessive gain can mask note definition and make everything sound muddy.
items: Start with less gain than you think you need

cards.title: Ignoring Clean Tone
cards.description: Distortion can't fix a bad clean tone. Start with a good clean sound, then add distortion as needed.
items: Good tone starts with good fundamentals

cards.title: Wrong Type for Style
cards.description: Using high-gain metal distortion for blues or light overdrive for metal won't serve the music.
items: Match distortion type to musical context

cards.title: No Dynamic Control
cards.description: Constant high-gain distortion removes dynamics and makes everything sound the same intensity.
items: Use distortion to enhance dynamics, not eliminate them
